STYLE: Warm, grainy 35mm film photograph, hand-painted texture, golden-hour light, earthy palette of ochre, deep green and faded blue, gentle contrast, soft dust in the air, Ethiopian highland town, intimate and unhurried.

COMPOSITION: subject centred, generous headroom, safe margins for cropping to both vertical and horizontal, no text, no watermark.
AVOID: text, watermark, logo, deformed hands, extra fingers
